newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor drops on speculation, higher arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India castor drops on speculation, higher arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed March delivery dropped further from 1,181/1,182 rupees to 1,173/1,174 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative offerings, dealers said on Tuesday.
"Sluggish overseas enquiries as well as higher new crop arrivals at the producing centres triggered fresh bull liquidation," one dealer said.
New crop arrivals of castorseed in Gujarat lifted to 25/30 thousand bags (75 kg each).

Groundnut oil looked up from 343/344 rupees to 346/347 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 70/80 tonnes while physical buying remained higher ahead of Hindu festivals, including the kite festival, one miller said.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
